text: {"quantities": [{"id": "q1", "value": 105, "unit": "members", "kind": "count", "span": "105 members"}, {"id": "q2", "value": 0.5, "unit": "", "kind": "count", "span": "half the number of players on the special teams as ... defense"}], "plan": [{"op": "add", "args": ["q2", "q2"], "out": "s1", "note": "measure the squad in defense-shares: two halves make one whole defense-share"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s1"], "out": "s2", "note": "the offense is twice the defense: two defense-shares"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s1", "s2"], "out": "s3", "note": "defense plus offense"}, {"op": "add", "args": ["s3", "q2"], "out": "s4", "note": "plus the special teams, which are half a defense-share"}, {"op": "div", "args": ["q1", "s4"], "out": "s5", "note": "the 105 members spread over those shares give one defense-share, i.e. the defense"}], "target": {"kind": "count", "scope": "how many players are on the defense"}, "dismissed": []}
